messages:
rachael-cs: Heads up  Sapphire wants a short pilot tomorrow on mex1. Req: mex1 edge, CIDR 191.100.24.0/24 allowlist, temp qps=2400 for 48h, autorevoke after. Theyre low on trial credits and mentioned renewal chat. Can infra confirm?
kai-eng: @ops-bot open provision ticket and run a quick capacity probe for mex1. Also ask which model variant and if streaming
ops-bot: Ticket PR-10521 opened. Capacity probe queued (ETA ~60m). Noted tenant=sapphire, qps=2400, cidr=191.100.24.0/24, duration=48h.
hernan-sapphire: Well use open-redwood-13b-quant (fallback to 7b-quant). Streaming enabled for demo. Demo spikes short bursts ~1.5k qps. Renewal decision Friday.
kai-eng: Good. Reserving 13b slot and enabling prefix KV cache. Will tag tenant sapphire-mex1 and schedule autorevoke. Command issued to infra.
ops-bot: PR-10521 update: capacity reserved, allowlist applied, cache pre-warmed. Autorevoke scheduled at 1767171121. Internal ID TLC-2107. Dashboards prepared.
lucy-sales: Looping sales  @rachael-cs please share renewal window and any SLA ask so we can prep a proposal.
rachael-cs: Renewal window end of week. Client asked about committed latency if mex1 stays on after pilot. Please prepare a draft SLA. Handoff call 09:00 PT tomorrow.
ops-bot: Reminder will post 1h before autorevoke. If team wants extended window, update PR before revoke time.
